default-grid-snap.name: Default grid snap button
default-grid-snap.description: Hide the 'GridSnap' button and use the default 'Snap' button (the one in the bottom right corner of the editor) instead.

anchor-snap-center.name: Snap anchor to the middle
anchor-snap-center.description: Snap the transform <co>anchor</c> not only to the lines of the grid but also to the centers of the grid cells

show-interface.name: Show transform rectangle
show-interface.description: Show the rectangle around selected objects during the transform

show-extra-ui-elements.name: Show extra UI elements
show-extra-ui-elements.description: Show new UI elements in addition to the transform rectangle
